what: The two inputs of T1's state-deconvolution row (pre-registration section 2.2 item 10; docs/t1_deconvolution_spec.md). Both files are git-ignored under data/external/; this record fixes their content. Metadata only: no cell-level or patient-level row is in this file.
atlas: Neftel C, et al. An Integrative Model of Cellular States, Plasticity, and Genetics for Glioblastoma. Cell 178:835-849.e21 (2019). doi:10.1016/j.cell.2019.06.024. GEO GSE131928 (the accession the pre-registration names).

expression.source: NCBI GEO, sample GSM3828672 of series GSE131928 (Smart-seq2, adult and paediatric IDH-wild-type glioblastoma, 28 tumours)
expression.content_checked: 23,686 gene symbols (no duplicate) x 7,930 cells. Values are log2(TPM/10 + 1): converted back, every cell's linear TPM sums to 1,000,000 (+/- 1). The file name says TPM; the scale is the one the Broad Single Cell Portal (SCP393) documents for its copy of the same matrix.

annotation.source: Curated Cancer Cell Atlas (3CA), Tirosh lab, Weizmann Institute: https://www.weizmann.ac.il/sites/3CA/brain, entry 'Neftel et al. 2019', 'Download Meta-data'. 3CA is described in Gavish A, et al. Nature 618:598-606 (2023), doi:10.1038/s41586-023-06130-4.

members.Meta-data_Neftel2019_Brain/SmartSeq2/Cel: 7,930 cells; columns include cell_name, sample, cell_type, malignant and the six Neftel meta-module scores MESlike2, MESlike1, AClike, OPClike, NPClike1, NPClike2. Every cell_name matches a column of the GEO matrix.
members.Meta-data_Neftel2019_Brain/10X/Cells.csv: 16,201 cells; no meta-module scores. Not used.

annotation.why_not_geo: The GEO series carries no per-cell malignant flag and no state assignment (its spreadsheet maps cells to tumour and age group only). The Broad Single Cell Portal copy (SCP393) returned HTTP 401 to an anonymous download on 2026-11-27. The Human Cell Atlas mirror holds the GEO files only.

terms.geo: No data licence is attached to the series. NCBI places no restriction on the use or distribution of GEO data; submitters may claim rights. The NCBI disclaimer page could not be read on 2026-11-27 (captcha), so its wording is UNVERIFIED.
terms.3ca: The 3CA brain page states no licence and no terms on 2026-11-27. UNVERIFIED. Cite Neftel et al. 2019 and Gavish et al. 2023.

not_downloaded: The 3CA expression archive Data_Neftel2019_Brain.tar.gz (467,866,008 bytes), the GEO 10x matrix, and the GEO RAW tar. Not needed: the GEO Smart-seq2 matrix is the expression input.
